title: Sort each line or place into the correct category
instructions: Drag each card on the left into the correct bin on the right. Some cards are about lines (parallels or meridians), and some are about places (which heat zone).

bins.name: Parallel (line of latitude)
bins.description: An east-west line; measured 0°-90° N or S.

bins.name: Meridian (line of longitude)
bins.description: A north-south line; measured 0°-180° E or W.

bins.name: Torrid Zone
bins.description: Hottest zone — between Tropic of Cancer and Tropic of Capricorn.

bins.name: Temperate Zone
bins.description: Mild zone — between a tropic and a polar circle.

bins.name: Frigid Zone
bins.description: Very cold zone — inside the polar circles.

items.name: A place at 50° N (e.g. London)
items.explanation: Between Tropic of Cancer (23½° N) and Arctic Circle (66½° N) → Temperate.

items.name: A place at 40° S
items.explanation: Between Tropic of Capricorn and Antarctic Circle → Temperate.

items.name: A place at 75° N
items.explanation: Inside the Arctic Circle (>66½° N) → Frigid.
